gaps.explanation: The report itself does not add up; no printed line carries the 58,982. General Fund Schedule 3 (pp5-8, printed pp22-25, consecutive, nothing missing from the trim) prints TOTAL CASH DISBURSEMENTS 689,434 (p8), equal to the Exhibit B General Fund column (p2), but its printed object lines add to 630,452, all of which are in detail[] (group totals as printed: Total general government 429,001 (p6; omits Zoning 481, lines add to 429,482) + Total Public Safety 154,744 + Total Public Works 18,239 + Total Public Welfare and Social Services 27,987 (p8)). 689,434 - 630,452 = 58,982 = gap. Every other fund ties: Road and Bridge 529,964, nonmajor combining Schedule 1 (p4) lines tie to the Exhibit B Other Governmental column. Only a printed subtotal/total could fill the gap, and subtotals are never added. No fix.
